text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
No, I am. It just hasn't settled in that this
is real
yet...
choice_data_list: そのわりに喜んでないみたい

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
My head and body feel all tingly. It's
like this is
just a dream.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Haha... I can't let you brush this off as a
mere
fantasy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
This is no dream. I hope you keep this
moment
locked tight in your heart.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
For today is the day you have finally
surpassed
Symboli Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'm delighted to see you finally achieve
the goal
you sought.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But more than that, I feel... frustration.
As if I
might be consumed by the raging
flame that
burns within me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Today I look upon Tokai Teio, the racer
who
stands above all others, and I long
with every
fiber of my being to defeat
her.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Heed my words, Monarch. The throne is
yours for
now, for one day I shall return
to reclaim it.
Prepare yourself for that
day.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yeah! ...I'll fight with all I got!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Well, it's time you head over
there.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
The whole crowd is cheering... and the
cheers are
all for me!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
choice_data_list: もう1度、勝者の姿を見せてこい！
もう1度、勝者の姿を見せてあげて！

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I am the Umamusume Monarch! The
great Tokai
Teio!
